qs.q: Patients with systemic lupus erythematosus who are prescribed chloroquine or hydroxychloroquine require routine screening by which specialist?
qs.e: People with lupus often have to be screened by an ophthalmologist if they are taking the antimalarial drugs chloroquine or hydroxychloroquine. This is to monitor for potential ocular toxicity.

qs.q: How should the dosage of chloroquine be calculated when treating P. vivax, P. ovale, or P. malariae infections?
o: Calculated strictly based on the salt form weight
Calculated using body surface area in square meters
Calculated using total tablet count regardless of weight
Calculated based on the base form equivalent
qs.e: Calculation of the dose for chloroquine is based on the BASE form, not the salt form, where 1 tablet of chloroquine phosphate 250mg is equivalent to 150mg base.
